extracted.name: Healthy Lemon Coconut Cookies w/ Maple Cream Cheese Frosting
extracted.description: It's insane to think these are healthy (yet expensive,) but, they are, and they're number 1! (Origin: thecandidadiet.com)
ingredient_lines: all the beans from 1 vanilla pod
1 tbsp lemon juice (freshly squeezed or bottled is fine)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C), and line a baking sheet with parchment.
In a measuring cup, mix the following ingredients: coconut milk, the beans of a whole vanilla pod, maple syrup, and lemon juice. Set it aside.
In a medium sized bowl, mix the following ingredients: almond flour, shredded coconut, chia seeds, lemon zest, and your pinch of salt.
Pour your liquid ingredients into your dry ingredients. Whisk/mix them together, forming a cookie-like dough.
Roll your dough into balls onto your baking sheet. After lining them up (about 2 inches away from each other,) flatten to cookie-looking shapes.
After cookies are flattened/shaped, put in oven for about 20 minutes.
Start on your maple cream cheese frosting. Mix half a block of cream cheese with 4 tbsp maple syrup. Whip them both together making a creamy icing.
While the cookies are baking, shred 1/4 cup of unsweetened shredded coconut in a food processor.
Take the cookies out when ready. Sprinkle shredded coconut dust all over cookies until all cookies are covered. Cool for a few minutes. Then, frost with maple cream cheese frosting. Enjoy!
